correctness.rationale: The full proof checks n>=2, every strictly positive rate, exact renewal spectral normalization, denominator nonvanishing, positivity of H(0), strict Hurwitz stability for all roots, monotone strictly positive derivative of the lifted phase and its exact limiting angle, and simple alternating crossings. At n=2,3 no plateau crossings; n=1 is separately excluded as exactly Poisson. A standalone 2221-assertion cross-check reconstructed the generator resolvent without relying on the same polynomial formula.

value.rationale: The mathematically natural observable is the number of above/below-Poisson noise transitions, which is an experimentally interpretable stage signature. The theorem proves this count rigid under any heterogeneous positive rates and provides exact identifiability up to an adjacent pair of stage numbers. This significantly strengthens the known uniform-rate special case in a physically common disorder direction; the rates do alter the crossing frequencies, so the rigidity is a genuine structural restriction rather than a parameter substitution.
